Ashtrom Renewable Energy is a subsidiary of Israel's Ashtrom Group; Group Chairperson is Rami Nussbaum -- the IA Second Amendment's other co-signatory for Heritage Solar is 'Oren Nussbaum,' same surname, plausibly a related/affiliated principal (not independently confirmed as family)

evidence: Ashtrom's own project page: 'Construction works start 2025' and lists the project under 'Under Construction' status as of this research date
Construction Review Online fact sheet: 'Construction Start: 2025'; article body: 'Construction of the 150 MWac facility across its 867-acre site southwest of San Antonio began in 2025'

CPS Energy newsroom PR (2026-05-12 groundbreaking ceremony): 'Construction of the El Patrimonio Project began in 2025' -- the public ceremony itself postdates the stated construction start by roughly a year, a common pattern for phased/ceremonial groundbreakings, not a red flag

No satellite imagery obtained this run (CDSE account-wide HTTP 402 'insufficient credits' -- confirmed via direct API test, not a tool bug); construction stage is therefore asserted from developer/press statements only, NOT independently visually verified
$200M BHI debt financing closed March 2026 plus a separate 10-yr PTC monetization deal -- capital actually deployed, a strong reality signal independent of imagery

reasoning_evidence: Latest signed contractual COD (First Amendment to IA, filed 2025-03-11) = 2027-03-30; the Second Amendment (2026-06-22) only replaced Exhibit C equipment specs and did not touch the Exhibit B schedule, so 2027-03-30 remains the latest contractual date
Queue's current claim 2027-04-29 is ~1 month after the latest signed contractual COD (2027-03-30) -- close and internally consistent

Developer's own materials (Ashtrom project page, Construction Review fact sheet) independently say 'second half of 2027' / 'Operational facility 2027' -- slightly later than the signed IA date, but same year, same general window

One prior schedule slip occurred: original IA (2023-12-11) COD 2026-08-09 -> First Amendment COD 2027-03-30 (~7 month slip), which is already baked into the current queue claim -- not a new/emerging risk

EIA-860M (2nd source, reports through 2026-05-01) still shows planned COD 2027-07 and status 'Regulatory approvals pending. Not under construction' -- this LAGS the developer's own construction-start claim and the signed IA; treated as reporting lag (a known EIA pattern, not a red flag) rather than counter-evidence, given the convergence of independent primary sources (CPS Energy PR, Ashtrom's own site, PUCT-filed IA/amendments, $200M financial close) all describing active 2025-started construction

Independent estimate: 2027-Q2 -- splits the signed-IA date (2027-03-30, Q1) and the developer's own 'second half of 2027' language (Q3), landing on Q2 as the central estimate; drift risk LOW because financing has closed, EPC/offtake are named and quoted, and no further schedule slip has occurred since the First Amendment (14+ months ago)
